function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Details | |-------|------------|---------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child Restraint** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021–545.023 | | **Headlights & Signal Use** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, or when visibility is reduced.
• Turn signals required 100 ft before turning or changing lanes. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop 20 ft from a school bus with flashing red lights.
• Vehicles may not pass a stopped bus until the lights stop flashing. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Do not drive in the left lane on highways unless overtaking. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking in front of a driveway or on a sidewalk. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021–545.023 | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Toll charges vary; payment accepted via electronic toll tags or cash. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) | | **Emergency Vehicle Rules** | • Drivers must pull over to the right and stop when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | ### How to Get Official Texts - **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online at the Texas Legislature’s website or through the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). - **Texas DMV** – Provides downloadable PDFs of the code, driver’s handbook, and specific regulations. - **TxDOT** – Offers maps, toll information, and updates on road conditions. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always obey posted signs** – they override general rules. 2. **Check for local ordinances** – cities like Austin or Dallas may have additional restrictions (e.g., speed limits, parking bans). 3. **Use the Texas DMV’s “Traffic Law” section** for up‑to‑date changes or clarifications. Feel free to ask if you need deeper details on a specific law or how to find the exact statutory language!
